story: Sara and Ivan talk about their big travel plans. They want to visit many different countries and continents. They plan to use many kinds of transport to travel.
title: Big Travel Plans
setting: A bright living room with a large world map on the wall.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: A young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater.

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: A young man with short black hair and a blue shirt.

sentences.en: Sara looks at a big world map.
sentences.zh: 萨拉看着一张巨大的世界地图。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara with long brown hair and a green sweater looks at a big world map on the wall.

sentences.en: She wants to visit Europe this summer.
sentences.zh: 她想在今年夏天游览欧洲。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara points her finger at Europe on the world map.

sentences.en: Ivan wants to go to Germany soon.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan with short black hair and a blue shirt looks at the map.

sentences.en: The trip to Australia is very far.
sentences.zh: 去澳大利亚的旅程非常遥远。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan points to Australia on the map, which is far away.

sentences.en: They can travel by a fast train.
sentences.zh: 他们可以乘坐快速的火车旅行。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small toy train sits on the table in front of them.

sentences.en: They might drive a car in America.
sentences.zh: 他们可能在美国开汽车。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara imagines a small car driving on a long road.

sentences.en: A bicycle is good for Mexico.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan imagines a bicycle leaning against a wall in Mexico.

sentences.en: They went to the airport yesterday.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara and Ivan look at a picture of a large airport.

sentences.en: Mexico is a country in the south.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥是一个位于南方的国家。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara points to the south part of the map near Mexico.

sentences.en: They also see Asia and Canada.
sentences.zh: 他们也看到了亚洲和加拿大。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan points to Asia and Canada on the large map.

sentences.en: The train station is very busy.
sentences.scene_prompt: A busy train station with many people and tracks.
